verdict.rationale: Kong's GitHub README describes plugin-based authentication and authorization for APIs using JWT, basic auth, OAuth, ACLs "and more". It also positions authentication as a core gateway function, with a quickstart for adding authentication to an API. JWT and OAuth2 enforcement via plugins is clearly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of API-key (key-auth) and mTLS enforcement, in-depth first-party plugin docs for the auth plugins, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
